note: On demand list prices from the AWS Price List API for us-east-1. No per query minimum is applied to the Athena figure, because the pricing page and the FAQ do not state one, so the query cost here is a lower bound. Storage is charged on the average stored volume over the month; the model charges the volume standing at the end of the simulated period, which overstates a lake that is still filling.
